Yes, the demand was too high on 16 June 2025. The peak demand reached **1324.4 kW** at **08:15**, which exceeded the plant's contract capacity of **1250.0 kW** [unverified citation removed].

There were two intervals where the demand was above the contract:
* **08:00**: 1307.1 kW [data: get_demand]

Reflow ovens must be switched off rather than left in standby because a standby state draws 36% of their 70 kW rating (25.2 kW) [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-02_weekend_shutdown.md#SOP-02 Weekend Shutdown > Why reflow ovens must be OFF, not standby].

In incident S5 (2025-10-17 to 2025-10-20), reflow oven RF-02 was left in standby all weekend, resulting in an excess energy consumption of approximately 1,210 kWh [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-02_weekend_shutdown.md#SOP-02 Weekend Shutdown > Why reflow ovens must be OFF, not standby].
